Who can apply
 Who can participate
 To participate in International Experience Canada (IEC), your country or territory of citizenship must have a youth mobility agreement (YMA) with Canada.
 Some countries only allow you to participate once. Others allow you to participate twice, but in different categories. Because each country is different, you should check your country’s eligibility requirements.
 Young Professionals employment eligibility requirements 
 The job you’re offered must count toward your “professional development.” To count, the job must be classified under Training, Education, Experience and Responsibilities (TEER) category 0, 1, 2 or 3 of the NOC .
 A TEER 4 job may qualify if it’s in your field of study. When you apply, you’ll need to submit your post-secondary 
 diploma
 certificate or
 degree
 You can’t participate with a refugee travel document
 You’re not eligible to participate in IEC if you hold a refugee travel document from any country .
 See eligibility by country and category .
 Get more support with recognized organizations
 Looking for more support before or during your participation? A recognized organization (RO) might be able to help you work and travel through IEC. Learn more about working and travelling in Canada using an RO .
